a.speaker: Juniper
text: Hello! I was going to say something important. It's gone now. Oh well, it's the Hollow.
Want some Dewbread? Baked fresh this morning. Or this evening. Whenever.

bought.speaker: Juniper
bought.text: Pleasure doing business! I'll forget it happened, but I'll feel good about it.

bye.speaker: Juniper
bye.text: Come back soon! I'll pretend to remember you.
